annotations.title: Sanctions list screening of a vault (paid)

description: One vault against the OFAC SDN list: its contract roles and its direct holders where the holder list is complete, exact address matches only, with the list version and whether it is current. Paid ($0.01). States: EXACT_LISTED_ADDRESS_MATCH (a match of an identifier, for review, not a finding about who controls it), NO_EXACT_MATCH (bounded: the list is not exhaustive, so this never means no sanctioned party), UNKNOWN (an incomplete holder list or a stale list). Never describe a result as clean, compliant or safe. Quote `says` and `limits`. `levels` says the two apart: `direct` (the holders and roles matched) and `beneficialOwners` (never screened); on a Hyperliquid child strategy the one direct holder is the parent vault, so screening it is not screening its depositors.
name: vault_sanctions_screening

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

candidates.description: Same EVM hex listed under another currency: for review, never a match.

limits.description: What this screening cannot show. Quote it.

listCurrent.description: False when our copy is past 36 hours: the state is then UNKNOWN.

matches.description: Each exact match with role, listed entity, programme and the official record link.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

notScreened.description: Addresses that should have been screened and were not.

state.description: EXACT_LISTED_ADDRESS_MATCH, NO_EXACT_MATCH (at least one address screened), NOT_SCREENED (none was) or UNKNOWN.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
